AI agents [9, 11] have shown growing promise in automating machine learning (ML) and data science

summary: A benchmark environment of 34 time series ML engineering challenges with artifact-level grading (submissions, code, models); it measures how well existing agents automate the work and reports weak agent results, with no time series obstacle isolated (its contamination check concerns benchmark integrity).
